title: Covering lifts characterize epimorphic families over a sheafified representable
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] in a universe containing its objects, morphisms and indexing sets [def-weil-size-convention], and take sheaves and presheaves of sets in that universe. For every $T\in\mathcal C$ put $h_T(V)=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C}(V,T)$, $H_T=h_T^\#$, and let $\eta_T:h_T\to H_T$ be the sheafification unit [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. Let $U\in\mathcal C$, let $I$ be a set, and let $(F_i,p_i:F_i\to H_U)_{i\in I}$ be a family of sheaves with morphisms. Write $p:\coprod_{i\in I}F_i\to H_U$ for the induced morphism from their coproduct in sheaves (a colimit of the discrete diagram [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]). Then $p$ is an epimorphism, meaning that for every sheaf $G$ and morphisms $f,g:H_U\to G$, the equality $f\circ p=g\circ p$ implies $f=g$, if and only if there exist a covering family $(u_a:V_a\to U)_{a\in A}$, a function $\iota:A\to I$, and sections $s_a\in F_{\iota(a)}(V_a)$ such that $p_{\iota(a),V_a}(s_a)=\eta_{U,V_a}(u_a)$ for every $a\in A$.

source.place: Tag 0D06, lemma-quasi-compact, forward proof before the use of quasi-compactness and the covering-surjectivity argument; Tag 00WT, lemma-covering-surjective-after-sheafification.

proof.text: First show that every sieve covering for $J^{\mathrm{Groth}}$ contains a presieve in $J$. Induct on the generated topology: a generator contains its generating presieve, the top sieve contains the identity cover, a pullback contains a chosen covering family of pullbacks of all arrows of a refining presieve, and a transitive covering contains the bind of the chosen refining presieves. These constructions use exactly the three clauses of [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]; indexing all distinct arrows avoids any stronger composition axiom for repeated families.

source.place: Tag 0D06, lemma-quasi-compact, forward proof before the use of quasi-compactness and the covering-surjectivity argument; Tag 00WT, lemma-covering-surjective-after-sheafification.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-small-sheaf-coproduct-labels] to obtain a coproduct model $S$, the labelled-section map $\eta:P\to S$ and injections $c_i$. Its universal property gives $q:S\to H_U$ with $c_iq=p_i$. By [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], $(\Sigma\operatorname{desc}c)q=\Sigma\operatorname{desc}p$. Thus if the latter is epi, $q$ is epi. The local-label clause shows that $\eta$ is locally surjective: the image sieve of every section contains the sieve generated by its actual labelling cover.

source.place: Tag 0D06, lemma-quasi-compact, forward proof before the use of quasi-compactness and the covering-surjectivity argument; Tag 00WT, lemma-covering-surjective-after-sheafification.

proof.text: By [lem-weil-pbc-site-sheaf-sets-epi-locally-surjective], $q$ is locally surjective. The composite $P\to S\to H_U$ is locally surjective, by transitivity of covering sieves and naturality. Apply this to $e=\eta_U(1_U)$, and use step 1 to choose an actual cover $R$ contained in its image sieve. Index $R$ by all its arrows, lifted to the common universe. Each arrow $a:V\to U$ then has a labelled section $(i,s)$ with $q\eta(i,s)=H_U(a)(e)$. The equations $c_iq=p_i$, $c_i(s)=\eta(i,s)$ and naturality of the representable sheafification unit give $p_i(s)=\eta_U(a)$. This supplies all required witnesses, including the empty-cover case.

source.place: Tag 0D06, lemma-quasi-compact, forward proof before the use of quasi-compactness and the covering-surjectivity argument; Tag 00WT, lemma-covering-surjective-after-sheafification.

proof.text: Conversely let the asserted covering lifts be given, and let $f,g:H_U\to G$ agree after $\Sigma\operatorname{desc}p$. Composing with every coproduct injection gives $p_if=p_ig$. For each covering arrow $a_b$, naturality identifies the restrictions of $f_U(e)$ and $g_U(e)$ with $f(p_{i(b)}(s_b))$ and $g(p_{i(b)}(s_b))$, hence makes them equal. Sheaf separatedness for this actual cover yields $f_U(e)=g_U(e)$. By the universe-lifted Yoneda lemma, this is equality of the presheaf maps $\eta_Uf$ and $\eta_Ug$. The sheafification universal property then gives $f=g$, proving epimorphic cancellation.

lean.statement: theorem site_epimorphic_family_iff_cover_lifts {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] (J : Precoverage C) (_hJ : J.IsSiteForCoverings) (U : C) {I : Type w} (F : I → Sheaf J.toGrothendieck (Type (max u v w))) (p : ∀ i : I, F i ⟶ (presheafToSheaf J.toGrothendieck (Type (max u v w))).obj (uliftYoneda.{max u w}.obj U)) : Epi (Sigma.desc p) ↔ ∃ (A : Type (max u v w)) (V : A → C) (a : ∀ b : A, V b ⟶ U) (ι : A → I) (s : ∀ b : A, (F (ι b)).obj.obj (op (V b))), Presieve.ofArrows V a ∈ J U ∧ ∀ b : A, (p (ι b)).hom.app (op (V b)) (s b) = (toSheafify J.toGrothendieck (uliftYoneda.{max u w}.obj U)).app (op (V b)) (ULift.up (a b))
